snippet.title: Console Archives RAIDEN PROJECT
snippet.description:
*The game includes only the Japanese version; the English version is not included. Please note that all in-game text is in Japanese only.

"RAIDEN PROJECT" was released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1995 for a 32-bit home console.
As a pilot of the ultra high-altitude fighter-bomber "RAIDEN" and "RAIDEN II", fight to save Earth from the invasion of Alien that suddenly appeared!
This title is a full-fledged vertical-scrolling shooting game that includes both "RAIDEN", an arcade vertical-scrolling shooting game released in 1990 that gained explosive popularity, and "RAIDEN II", which was released three years later and was also very popular.

The "Console Archives" series is developed with the concept of faithfully reproducing masterpieces released on various home game consoles, allowing players to easily enjoy them on the latest hardware.
The series is packed with convenient features, including customizable button layouts and screen settings, as well as the ability to save and load at any point.
Whether you played them back in the day or are experiencing them for the first time, please enjoy the masterpieces that shaped the history of console gaming!
